scope: Tribunale di riferimento per sequestro civile se la nave giunge nel porto dichiarato; non determina la competenza sul merito né i presupposti del credito.

KRPTK.name: Suwon District Court · Pyeongtaek Branch
KRPTK.note: Pyeongtaek jurisdiction; terminals on the Dangjin side require confirmation with local counsel.

KRMAS.name: Changwon District Court · Masan Branch
KRMAS.note: Conservatory arrest before the court at the vessel location or the court hearing the substantive claim.

KRTSN.name: Daejeon District Court · Seosan Branch
KRTSN.note: Jurisdiction covering Seosan, Dangjin and Taean.

KRTAN.name: Daejeon District Court · Seosan Branch
KRTAN.note: Jurisdiction covering Seosan, Dangjin and Taean.

KRKAN.name: Gwangju District Court · Suncheon Branch
KRKAN.note: Gwangyang jurisdiction; confirm the actual terminal.

KRUSN.name: Ulsan District Court
KRUSN.note: Ulsan territorial court; verify vessel location and requirements for relief.

GBTIL.name: High Court of Justice · Admiralty Court (London)
GBTIL.note: Reference for England and Wales; Scotland and Northern Ireland have separate regimes.

USBAL.name: U.S. District Court · District of Maryland (Baltimore)
USBAL.note: In rem arrest under Supplemental Rule C; attachment of assets has different requirements.

USTPA.name: U.S. District Court · Middle District of Florida (Tampa)
USTPA.note: In rem arrest under Supplemental Rule C; verify the nature of the claim.

USSAN.name: U.S. District Court · Southern District of California (San Diego)
USSAN.note: Federal territorial reference; local arrest rules and the claim require confirmation.

INMAA.name: Madras High Court · Chennai (Admiralty)
INMAA.note: Coastal High Court for Tamil Nadu; in rem arrest under the Admiralty Act 2017.

sources.title: Ministero: giurisdizione delle High Courts costiere

GHTEM.name: High Court of Ghana · Tema
GHTEM.note: Territorial High Court reference; confirm the division and filing arrangements locally.

EGPSD.name: Economic Court with territorial jurisdiction · Port Said
EGPSD.note: Confirm with Egyptian counsel; the coastal urgent applications judge may have jurisdiction.

EGSKT.name: Economic Court with territorial jurisdiction · Alexandria
EGSKT.note: For Sidi Kerir, confirm terminal jurisdiction and the urgent applications judge. The stated venue is preliminary.

OMDQM.name: Court of Investment and Commerce · Duqm · Al Wusta
OMDQM.note: Commercial claims: urgent applications judge of the first-instance section. Reform effective from 01.10.25; verify claim type and exceptions.

OMSOH.name: Court of Investment and Commerce · Sohar · North Al Batinah
OMSOH.note: Commercial claims: urgent applications judge of the first-instance section. Reform effective from 01.10.25; verify claim type and exceptions.

PECLL.name: Juzgado Civil del Callao
PECLL.note: Preliminary territorial reference; specific ship arrest jurisdiction was not verified in the consulted sources.

BRPNG.name: Vara Cível da Comarca de Paranaguá
BRPNG.note: Preliminary territorial reference for private claims; specific arrest jurisdiction and potentially concurrent venues require verification.

CNYTG.name: Qingdao Maritime Court · Yantai Tribunal
CNYTG.note: The branch covers Yantai ports and waters and accepts pre-action arrest applications.

CNYAT.name: Qingdao Maritime Court · Yantai Tribunal
CNYAT.note: The branch covers Yantai ports and waters and accepts pre-action arrest applications.

CNSHG.name: Shanghai Maritime Court
CNSHG.note: Jurisdiction over Shanghai waters, including Yangshan; arrest under the Special Maritime Procedure Law.

CNSGH.name: Shanghai Maritime Court
CNSGH.note: Jurisdiction over Shanghai waters, including Yangshan; arrest under the Special Maritime Procedure Law.

USBNC.name: U.S. District Court · Eastern District of California (Sacramento)
USBNC.note: Benicia, Solano County: Sacramento division. In rem arrest under Supplemental Rule C and local admiralty rules; confirm terminal and vessel location.

SG.name: General Division of the High Court · Singapore
SG.note: Warrant of arrest and Sheriff intervention within Singapore port limits.

JM.name: Supreme Court of Judicature of Jamaica · Kingston
JM.note: Admiralty jurisdiction; in rem ship arrest procedure.

BS.name: Supreme Court of The Bahamas · Nassau

PA.name: Tribunales Marítimos de Panamá · Panama City
PA.note: First or Second Maritime Court, according to allocation; not the appellate court.

LK.name: Commercial High Court · Colombo (Admiralty)
LK.note: Admiralty jurisdiction exercised in Colombo, including for Hambantota.

MX.name: Juzgado de Distrito at the vessel location
MX.note: For Lázaro Cárdenas, the territorially competent federal court in Michoacán; venue and allocation require confirmation. Article 274 LNCM.
